_comment: Polygon zones are CAMERA-SPECIFIC: coordinates are pixels at the camera's resolution (frame_wh below, for documentation only). Define one config per physical camera. Draw shelf zones over merchandise, an exit zone over the door. 'anchors' decides which point of a person's box must fall inside the polygon to count as present (BOTTOM_CENTER = feet, good for 'standing at the shelf'). 'dwell_alert_seconds' is an optional loiter threshold per zone.
